name: Mothers Staying Home With Kids
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of mothers in nurturing and managing their households with diligence and godly wisdom. Honoring parents is commanded, promising longevity and blessing, while training children in the way they should go ensures lasting faithfulness. The Proverbs 31 woman exemplifies attentiveness to her home, avoiding idleness, and Titus instructs older women to teach sound doctrine and godly behavior, underscoring the importance of mothers cultivating holiness and instruction within the family.
